name: Cable Kneeling Rear Delt Row
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and kneel facing the machine with torso upright.
Grasp both rope ends with palms facing down and arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the rope toward your upper chest while driving your elbows wide and back.
Pause briefly with your rear delts squeezed, then extend your arms forward under control.
tips: Keep your elbows just below shoulder height as they pass your torso.
Avoid leaning backward or shrugging your shoulders to finish the row.
